method: Text runs identical in the English and isiZulu captures of the same view, sorted by rule. Heuristic: check the lists.

rules.translated: the isiZulu run does not occur in the English capture
rules.figures, units and dates: only digits, punctuation, units and month names remain
rules.crop, plant, bed and app names: a catalogue crop name, one of the sample farm's four plants, "Bed n"/"Plot n", or an app name, optionally followed by figures
rules.sentences of 9 or more words: guidance, caveats and explanations. Some of this is sourced farming copy that must stay English until reviewed; this script cannot tell which
rules.short labels of 8 words or fewer: headings, buttons, field labels and status words, and fragments of them where a label is split across elements: the interface text that could carry an isiZulu draft
